title: Bonus Event Day Test for a Late-Credited Purchase — Finch Circle Order Channel Table
content:
In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the day tested for the bonus event indicator depends on how the unit was bought: an online, app or phone order that was not collected by store pickup is tested on its ship date; a store pickup order is tested on its pickup date (its completed date); any other purchase is tested on its purchase date; the indicator is 1 when a bonus event points entry is posted on the day tested and 0 otherwise.

How the unit was bought is read from the claimed unit's purchase record under Merchandise Purchases: the channel (in store, online, app or phone order), the fulfillment (store pickup or not), the ship date, the completed date and the purchase date. The bonus event points entries are read from the membership's own points history, by their posting date.

## Day tested

| Channel | Collected by store pickup | Day tested |
|---|---|---|
| Online, app or phone order | no | the ship date |
| Any channel | yes (a store pickup order) | the pickup date, which is the completed date |
| In store | no | the purchase date |

| Bonus event points entry posted on the day tested | Bonus event indicator |
|---|---|
| yes | 1 |
| no | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

| Purchase | Purchase date | Ship date | Completed date | Day tested | Bonus event entry posted that day | Indicator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Online order shipped to the home | 3 May | 6 May | 9 May | 6 May | yes | 1 |
| App order collected at a store pickup counter | 3 May | — | 8 May | 8 May | no | 0 |
| Bought at a register in store | 20 May | — | 20 May | 20 May | yes | 1 |
